name: score-matrix
title: Score Matrix
description: A dark score card: the figure counts up as a dot grid lights to its share, beside rows of counting metrics.

perf.budget: The dot grid is two Skia paths, the lit one rebuilt on the UI thread for about a second; figures count up by re-rendering their text. Nothing animates at rest.

a11y.reducedMotion: The score, dots and metric values appear at once.
a11y.screenReader: The score reads as one line ("Athletic score: 13 out of 100") and each metric as one line ("Strength: 170 lbs").
